purpose: Candidate clean-water NEGATIVES for evaluating runs/water/litter_detector/weights/best.pt (blocker B1).
verdict: INADEQUATE - see acceptance_failures. Retained as a record of what was searched, not as a usable negative set.

acceptance_failures.N2_no_litter_verified: NOT verified per image. Requirement is human verification per image, not sampled.
acceptance_failures.N3_specular_reflections: FAIL - frames are featureless close-ups; no sky/cloud/bank reflections.
acceptance_failures.N4_vegetation: FAIL - no surface or overhanging vegetation visible.
acceptance_failures.N5_surface_states: FAIL - single surface state; no ripple/wake variety.
acceptance_failures.N6_shadows: FAIL - no cast shadows across water.

provenance_note: Alta/Baja/Media are unlabelled 450x450 turbidity close-ups. Not listed in docs/DATASET_PROVENANCE.md; source and licence not established here.
training_overlap: Detector trained on runs/water/tudgv_yolo (TUD-GV). Alta/Baja/Media are a different corpus, so no train/test overlap - but that is the only provenance claim supported.
